methodology: This adapter reads the public Artificial Analysis homepage payload, groups scored models by the lab that created them, and ranks each lab by the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index of its best released model. Historical frames are Internet Archive captures of the same homepage, so past standings reflect what Artificial Analysis actually published at the time. Recent frames replay model release dates, so a lab's tower jumps the day it ships a stronger frontier model.

historical.source: Internet Archive captures of the Artificial Analysis homepage
notes: Each historical frame is the Artificial Analysis homepage model table as captured by the Internet Archive, grouped into labs by best-model Intelligence Index — the standings as actually published at the time.
Coverage starts February 2026 because Artificial Analysis rebased the Intelligence Index for 2026; pre-rebase captures exist but their scores are not comparable with current values.
Labs missing from a capture (Artificial Analysis periodically trims its homepage roster) are omitted from that frame rather than zero-filled.

relationships.reason: The lab race is the model-level frontier index rolled up to the labs that ship the models.
One ranks labs by benchmark capability, the other by public attention.
The same labs fight for the top of the arena Elo board.
Lab capability shows up directly in long-horizon coding pass rates.
Frontier lab strength drives which models people download and use.
